name: data-cdc
description: data.cdc.gov is the CDC's open-data portal (Socrata). This CLI searches the dataset catalog, lists categories and tags, reads dataset metadata, and queries or exports dataset rows through the public Socrata Discovery, SODA and views APIs.

commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search the data.cdc.gov catalog by keyword, with optional category/tag/type filters, sort order and paging

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search keywords

params.name: categories
params.description: Filter by domain category name. Get the names from list-categories, e.g. 'Vaccinations' or 'National Center for Health Statistics'.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter by domain tag. Get the tags from list-tags, e.g. 'flu' or 'covid-19'.

params.name: only
params.description: Restrict results to one asset type

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order. Relevance is used when omitted.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, for paging

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List all dataset categories on data.cdc.gov with their dataset counts

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List the most-used dataset tags on data.cdc.gov with their counts

commands.name: autocomplete-datasets
commands.summary: Suggest dataset titles that match a partial search term

params.name: q
params.description: Partial title text

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one dataset by its 4x4 id, including columns, field names, data types and stats

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset 4x4 id, e.g. ynw2-4viq

commands.name: get-dataset-metadata
commands.summary: Get a dataset's catalog metadata: tags, contact info, custom fields, ISO update dates and API/web URIs

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset 4x4 id, e.g. vh55-3he6

commands.name: query-rows
commands.summary: Query a dataset's rows with SoQL (SODA API): filter, full-text search, select/aggregate, group, sort and page

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset 4x4 id, e.g. ynw2-4viq (find ids with search-datasets)

params.name: where
params.description: SoQL filter expression on column field names (see get-dataset columns.fieldName), e.g. jurisdiction='United States'

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search across all row values

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated columns or aggregates, e.g. geography,count(*)

params.name: group
params.description: Columns to group by. Use together with an aggregate in select.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort expression, e.g. 'week_ending_date DESC'

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return (sent to the site as "$limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of rows to skip, for paging (sent as "$offset")

commands.name: run-soql-query
commands.summary: Run a full SoQL query string against a dataset through the v3 query API, e.g. 'select jurisdiction, sum(influenza_deaths) group by jurisdiction limit 10'

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset 4x4 id

params.name: query
params.description: SoQL query string (SELECT ... WHERE ... GROUP BY ... ORDER BY ... LIMIT ...), without a FROM clause
params.example: select jurisdiction, sum(influenza_deaths) group by jurisdiction limit 10

example.query: select jurisdiction, sum(influenza_deaths) group by jurisdiction limit 10

commands.name: export-rows
commands.summary: Download a dataset export in JSON: view metadata under meta, rows as positional arrays under data

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset 4x4 id

params.name: max_rows
params.description: Maximum number of rows to export. Omit for the full dataset, which can be very large.

commands.name: get-data-catalog
commands.summary: Get the full DCAT (Project Open Data) catalog of every public dataset on data.cdc.gov

notes: Datasets are identified by a Socrata 4x4 id such as 'ynw2-4viq'. In search-datasets results this is resource.id.
Column names for query-rows and run-soql-query are the fieldName values in get-dataset's columns array, e.g. week_ending_date or influenza_deaths.
SODA returns every value as a string. Numeric comparisons in $where still work on number-typed columns.
/resource/{id}.csv export failed during recording; use query-rows (JSON) or export-rows instead.
export-rows returns rows as positional arrays. Map them to columns using meta.view.columns.
The v3 query API (run-soql-query) may require an app token for anonymous use. If it fails, use query-rows with $select/$where/$group/$order.
The /browse HTML catalog is blocked by robots.txt; search-datasets uses the public Discovery API.
